text_en: “I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I look upon a virgin?
text_cn: 我同我的眼立了约，决不注视处女。

text_en: What would be my portion from God above, and my heritage from the Almighty on high?
text_cn: 天主由上所注定的一分是什么？全能者由高处所给的产业是什么？

text_en: Does not calamity befall the unrighteous, and disaster the workers of iniquity?
text_cn: 岂不是为恶人注定了丧亡，为作孽的人注定了灾殃？

text_en: Does he not see my ways, and number all my steps?
text_cn: 他岂不监视我的行径，计算我的脚步？

text_en: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit—
text_cn: 我若与虚伪同行，我的脚若趋向诡诈，

text_en: let me be weighed in a just balance, and let God know my integrity! —
text_cn: 愿天主以公正的天平秤量我，他必知道我的纯正。

text_en: if my step has turned aside from the way, and my heart has followed my eyes, and if any spot has clung to my hands;
text_cn: 我的脚步如果离开了正道，我的心如果随从了眼目之所见，我的手若持有不洁，

text_en: then let me sow, and another eat; and let what grows for me be rooted out.
text_cn: 那么，我种的，情愿让别人来吃；我栽的，情愿让别人拔出。

text_en: “If my heart has been enticed by a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbor’s door;
text_cn: 我的心如果为妇女所迷，我如果曾在邻人门口等候妇女，

text_en: then let my wife grind for another, and let other men kneel over her.
text_cn: 就让我的妻子给人推磨，让别人与她同寝。

text_en: For that would be a heinous crime; that would be a criminal offense;
text_cn: 因为这是淫行，是应受严刑的罪恶；

text_en: for that would be a fire consuming down to Abaddon, and it would burn to the root all my harvest.
text_cn: 是一种焚烧至毁灭的火，烧尽我全部产业的火。

text_en: “If I have rejected the cause of my male or female slaves, when they brought a complaint against me;
text_cn: 当我的仆婢与我争执时，我若轻视他们的权利，

text_en: what then shall I do when God rises up? When he makes inquiry, what shall I answer him?
text_cn: 天主起来时，我可怎么办呢？他若追问，我可怎样回答？

text_en: Did not he who made me in the womb make them? And did not one fashion us in the womb?
text_cn: 在母胎造成我的，不是也造了他们？在母胎形成我们的，不是只有他一个？

text_en: “If I have withheld anything that the poor desired, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
text_cn: 我何时曾拒绝了穷苦人的渴望，我何时曾使寡妇的眼目颓丧？

text_en: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the orphan has not eaten from it—
text_cn: 我何时独自吃食物，而没有与孤儿共享？

text_en: for from my youth I reared the orphan like a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow —
text_cn: 因为天主自我幼年，就像父亲教养了我；自我出了母胎，就引导了我。

text_en: if I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, or a poor person without covering,
text_cn: 如果我见了无衣蔽体的乞丐，无遮盖的穷人，

text_en: whose loins have not blessed me, and who was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
text_cn: 如果他的心没有向我道谢，没有以我的羊毛获得温暖，

text_en: if I have raised my hand against the orphan, because I saw I had supporters at the gate;
text_cn: 如果我在城门口见有支持我者，就举手攻击无罪者，

text_en: then let my shoulder blade fall from my shoulder, and let my arm be broken from its socket.
text_cn: 那么，让我的肩由胛骨脱落，我的胳膊由肘处折断！

text_en: For I was in terror of calamity from God, and I could not have faced his majesty.
text_cn: 因为天主的惩罚使我惊骇，因他的威严，我站立不住。

text_en: “If I have made gold my trust, or called fine gold my confidence;
text_cn: 我何尝以黄金为依靠，对纯金说过：“你是我的靠山？”

text_en: if I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, or because my hand had gotten much;
text_cn: 我何尝因财产丰富，手赚的多而喜乐过？

text_en: if I have looked at the sun when it shone, or the moon moving in splendor,
text_cn: 我何时见太阳照耀，月亮皎洁徐行，

text_en: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my mouth has kissed my hand;
text_cn: 我的心遂暗中受到迷惑，我的口遂亲手送吻？

text_en: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I should have been false to God above.
text_cn: 这也是应受严罚的罪过，因为我背弃了至高的天主。

text_en: “If I have rejoiced at the ruin of those who hated me, or exulted when evil overtook them—
text_cn: 我何时庆幸恨我者遭殃，见他遭遇不幸而得意？

text_en: I have not let my mouth sin by asking for their lives with a curse—
text_cn: 其实，我没有容我的口犯罪，诅咒过他的性命。

text_en: if those of my tent ever said, ‘O that we might be sated with his flesh! ’ —
text_cn: 我帐幕内的人是否有人说过：“某人没有吃饱主人给的肉？”

text_en: the stranger has not lodged in the street; I have opened my doors to the traveler—
text_cn: 外方人没有睡在露天地里，我的门常为旅客敞开。

text_en: if I have concealed my transgressions as others do, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom,
text_cn: 我的田地若控告我，犁沟若一同哀诉，

text_en: because I stood in great fear of the multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and did not go out of doors—
text_cn: 我若吃田中的产物而不付代价，或叫地主心灵悲伤，

text_en: O that I had one to hear me! (Here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! ) O that I had the indictment written by my adversary!
text_cn: 愿此地不再长小麦而长荆棘，不长大麦而长恶草。

text_en: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; I would bind it on me like a crown;
text_cn: 我岂像凡人一样，掩饰过我的过犯，把邪恶隐藏在胸中？

text_en: I would give him an account of all my steps; like a prince I would approach him.
text_cn: 我岂怕群众的吵闹？亲族的谩骂岂能吓住我，使我不敢作声，杜门不出？

text_en: “If my land has cried out against me, and its furrows have wept together;
text_cn: 惟愿天主俯听我，这是我最后的要求：愿全能者答复我！我的对方所写的状词，

text_en: if I have eaten its yield without payment, and caused the death of its owners;
text_cn: 我把它背在肩上，编成我的冠冕。

text_en: let thorns grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of barley. ” The words of Job are ended.
text_cn: 我将像王侯一样走向他面前，向他一一陈述我的行为。──约伯的话至此为止。
